Class Position

java.lang.Object
iscteiul.ista.battleship.Position
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPosition
public class Position extends java.lang.Object implements IPosition
Stores a pair of zero-based board coordinates with mutable occupancy and shot flags. Coordinates are not checked against board boundaries. Equality uses only the row and column, and adjacency includes overlapping and diagonal positions.
